Name: Cute Furniture
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
Finally done with the beds and now here is ~Cute Furniture~ ヾ(≧∇≦)ゞ

[/size]︶︶︶ ⊹ ︶︶︶⠀୨♡୧⠀︶︶︶ ⊹ ︶︶︶
[size=4]UPDATE: [/size][size=3]a Spanish translation is now availible for the content patcher version! Thank you to Hayato2236 !!!  (≧∇≦)
[/size][size=4]UPDATE: an ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES version is live, thanks to the wonderful queenquackin ! <3 ☆⌒(ゝ。∂)[/size]
︶︶︶ ⊹ ︶︶︶⠀୨♡୧⠀︶︶︶ ⊹ ︶︶︶

NOTE: So far, this mod ONLY has couches (14) and armchairs (7). However, this will be the mod that I continue to update as I create more cute furniture in the original 7 colour ways. I will also continue to update both: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34650]Green Cute Furniture[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34472]Desaturated Cute Furniture[/url] with all future 'cute' series furniture and decor. (At the time of posting, they have also been updated with couches + chairs!

[size=3]₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ I released [url=https://youtu.be/mU9H2whIVm4]THIS youtube video[/url] as well as this updated [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/AQRsERzRp4c]Youtube Short[/url]﻿ showcasing the Cute Furniture Series + the desaturated/green versions![/size][size=3]! Check it out if you desire <3  ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊[/size]
﻿
﻿٩(ˊᗜˋ*)و ♡ [size=4]BOTH ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES AND CONTENT PATCHER VERSIONS ARE AVAILIBLE IN THE 'FILES' TAB!  (thanks, queenquackin!) Alternative textures are for: brown armchair, brown couch + large brown couch
[/size]
What can you expect with this mod?
the 2 seater couch takes "Loveseat" to the next level- with a heart pillow! Perfect for you and your spouse to cuddle <3 The 3 seater, "Lounge Sofa" has 4 squishy pillows- and, both couches feature a cute ruffle detail at the bottom! The 'Nook Seat' will be your farmers new ideal reading chair! 

︶︶︶ ⊹ ︶︶︶⠀୨♡୧⠀︶︶︶ ⊹ ︶︶︶

[size=2]PLANNED UPDATES FOR THIS MOD:
- tables and chairs
- lighting and decorations
[/size](I will work on these two updates first and then circle back and add more <3 ^)

OTHER PROJECTS I'M WORKING ON:
Well, a quick note to say I will take a few days to a week off of making furniture (not taking time off of mod-making just furniture mod specific haha!). Id like to get out a few more youtube videos and make some other mods! Here are the mods you can expect from me next:
-a really cute tiny frog mod that you're going to want for your farm! This will be coming out next! (finally have been able to get around to this!)
-a portrait/character sprite pack for all 6 bachelorettes <3 (I want to make them all extra cute with.... a saucy secret flare ☆🧹 -*
-CUTE nursery furniture!! Ideally, I will release a full pack of nursery furniture before I circle back to an update for this series here!
-a furniture catalogue for all of my furniture mods! :3
and so much more.... my ideas are endless and I am so grateful that I get to create them and put them out into the world, should one hundred people use it, or none! I just like making art and I want to contribute to your playthrough being as cute as it can be!

[size=2]How to install:[/size]
[size=2]1. ensure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher OR Alternative Textures installed[/size]
[size=2]2. download my file (whichever you prefer- AT or CP)[/size]
[size=2]3. unzip the file into your 'Mods' folder[/size]
[size=2]you will now have cute furniture in your game!
